name: Kisora Tsubasa
source:
He is the leader of the team you are a part of. He is calm, cool, and collected and is very skillful at assessing the situation. He is always at the front, leading the group, in order to protect his friends. He is bitten in the prologue, but the antibodies within his body protect him from turning into a zombie. His goal is to reach the Clock Tower that is the last hope for saving what’s left of humanity.

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.zombiekaigai&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
